context: Maya talks to Daniel about working in different countries.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do. Every office has its own etiquette and its own norm.
dialogue: Maya: Daniel, do you want to work in another country one day?
Daniel: Yes. I want to learn a different way of doing things.
Maya: Good. Remember, when in Rome, do as the Romans do.
Daniel: True. Every office has its own etiquette.
Priya: Yes. And culture shock is normal at first.
Maya: Exactly. Learn the norm, and you will fit in well.
lessons.listening: On Monday, Maya talks to Daniel about working in different countries. She says, 'When in Rome, do as the Romans do. Every office has its own etiquette and its own norm.' Daniel says, 'I want to learn a different way of doing things.' Priya says, 'Yes. Culture shock is normal at first. Learn the norm, and you will fit in well.' Daniel is happy.
lessons.question: What does Maya tell Daniel to do?
lessons.correct: Follow the ways of a new place
lessons.reading: On Monday, Maya talks to Daniel about working in different countries at Carter Retail Group. She says, 'When in Rome, do as the Romans do. Every office has its own etiquette and its own norm. A new worker must learn the norm fast.' Daniel says, 'I want to learn a different way of doing things. I want to work in Tokyo one day. The office where I work now is in London, but I want to see a new place.' Priya says, 'Yes. Culture shock is normal at first. Every country has a different way of doing things. Learn the etiquette, and people will help you.' Maya says, 'Good. The office where I work has people from ten countries. We learn from each other every day. When in Rome, do as the Romans do, and you will fit in well.' Daniel is happy. He says, 'Thank you, Maya. I will learn the norm of a new office.'
lessons.readingQ: What does Maya tell Daniel to do?
lessons.readingA: Follow the ways of a new place, and learn its norm.
lessons.speaking: Tell a friend about working in a different country. What is different there? What would you learn?

Every office has its own etiquette and its own norm. Culture shock is normal at first. I want to learn a different way of doing things. I will learn the norm, and I will fit in well.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend. Tell them about working in a different country. Say what is different and what you would learn.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Tom, I want to tell you about working in a different country. On Monday, Maya talked about offices in other countries. She said, 'When in Rome, do as the Romans do.' lessons.readingA: Learn how to work across time zones.
lessons.speaking: Tell a friend about working across time zones. How does your team work? What is hard about it?
lessons.speakingSample: I want to tell you about working across time zones with a global team. On Sunday, Maya talked about our global team. She said, 'Our team works across time zones. We have a two-hour overlap for meetings every day.' We are a hybrid team, and we are diverse and open. It is important that everyone be on time for the call every day.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend. Tell them about working across time zones. Say how your team works and what is hard about it.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Tom, I want to tell you about working across time zones. On Sunday, Maya talked about our global team. She said, 'Our team works across time zones. We have a two-hour overlap for meetings every day.' We are a hybrid team, and we are diverse and open. It is important that everyone be on time for the call. I will learn more about global work every day. Please tell me about your team. Best, Daniel
lessons.sound: Overlap has its strongest beat on VER. In overlap, say VER clearly in the middle. In hybrid, say HY clearly at the start.
lessons.model: We have a two-hour overlap for meetings.
lessons.wordSample: It is a time when two things happen at the same time.

newItems.definition: To change how you act for a new place or situation.

newItems.definition: A wrong idea about what someone means.
newItems.example: A small misunderstanding can cause a big problem.

newItems.definition: To help two different groups understand each other.
newItems.example: Good leaders bridge the gap between teams.

newItems.definition: The time it takes to learn something new.
newItems.example: A new job has a learning curve.

newItems.word: a step in the right direction
newItems.definition: A small change that makes things better.
newItems.example: The new plan is a step in the right direction.

context: Daniel meets Sara at an international work fair.
Good leaders bridge the gap between teams. You must adapt to a new culture, and a small misunderstanding can cause a big problem.
dialogue: Daniel: Sara, have you worked in another country before?
Sara: Not yet. I want to adapt to a new culture.
Daniel: Good. A new job has a learning curve.
Sara: Yes. I want to bridge the gap between teams.
Daniel: You can. It is a step in the right direction.
Sara: Thank you. I will learn, and I will not fear a misunderstanding.
